DLG-SC-KNG-KAWASAKI-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KNG-KAWASAKI-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 交代の記録は受け取りましたか。
DLG-SC-KNG-KAWASAKI-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you received the shift-handover record?

DLG-SC-KNG-KAWASAKI-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KNG-KAWASAKI-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。署名しましたが、保全担当がまだ作業中です。
DLG-SC-KNG-KAWASAKI-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 交代署名と保全継続を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KNG-KAWASAKI-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I signed it, but the maintenance staff are still working.
DLG-SC-KNG-KAWASAKI-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report the handover signature and continuing maintenance in Japanese.

DLG-SC-KNG-KAWASAKI-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KNG-KAWASAKI-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 再開の指示は出ていますか。
DLG-SC-KNG-KAWASAKI-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have instructions to restart been issued?

DLG-SC-KNG-KAWASAKI-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KNG-KAWASAKI-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: いえ、受領の署名だけです。機械は動かしません。
DLG-SC-KNG-KAWASAKI-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 再開指示未受領で待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KNG-KAWASAKI-001-SHARED-04.translation: No, I only signed for receipt. I will not run the machine.
DLG-SC-KNG-KAWASAKI-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you have no restart instruction and will wait.

DLG-SC-KNG-KAWASAKI-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KNG-KAWASAKI-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 停止中の対象を確認します。
DLG-SC-KNG-KAWASAKI-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will confirm which machine is stopped.

DLG-SC-KNG-KAWASAKI-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KNG-KAWASAKI-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 二号機です。隣の一号機が動いても同じ扱いにしません。
DLG-SC-KNG-KAWASAKI-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 対象機を隣機と区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KNG-KAWASAKI-001-SHARED-06.translation: It is machine number two. Even if number one beside it runs, I will not treat them the same.
DLG-SC-KNG-KAWASAKI-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish the target machine from the adjacent one in Japanese.

DLG-SC-KNG-KAWASAKI-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KNG-KAWASAKI-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 製品は残っていますか。

DLG-SC-KNG-KAWASAKI-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KNG-KAWASAKI-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 台に三個あります。途中品として場所を報告します。
DLG-SC-KNG-KAWASAKI-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 途中品の個数と場所を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KNG-KAWASAKI-001-SHARED-08.translation: There are three on the stand. I will report their location as work in progress.
DLG-SC-KNG-KAWASAKI-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: State the number and location of unfinished products in Japanese.

DLG-SC-KNG-KAWASAKI-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KNG-KAWASAKI-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 保全の終了と作業指示を担当が確認します。
DLG-SC-KNG-KAWASAKI-001-SHARED-09.translation: The responsible staff will confirm completion of maintenance and work instructions.

DLG-SC-KNG-KAWASAKI-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KNG-KAWASAKI-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 担当名と再開条件を聞いてから、自分の作業を復唱します。
DLG-SC-KNG-KAWASAKI-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 担当と再開条件を復唱確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KNG-KAWASAKI-001-SHARED-10.translation: After hearing who is responsible and the restart conditions, I will repeat back my own task.
DLG-SC-KNG-KAWASAKI-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Repeat and confirm the responsible person and restart conditions in Japanese.

DLG-SC-KNG-KAWASAKI-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KNG-KAWASAKI-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 二号機と三個の状態を引き継ぎます。署名を再開許可とはせず、指定位置でお待ちください。
DLG-SC-KNG-KAWASAKI-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will pass on the status of number two and the three products. Do not treat the signature as permission to restart; please wait in the designated position.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like advice about a notification?

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 二台使っています。この終了通知はどちらですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二台の通知対象を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: We are using two machines. Which one does this completion notice refer to?
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese which of the two machines the notification concerns.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 機械番号を確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Can you check the machine numbers?

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 私のは三番、友人のは五番です。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 所有者と機械番号を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Mine is number three, and my friend's is number five.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State the users and machine numbers in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 通知の番号は五番ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: The number on the notification is five.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では私の三番は終わったと決めず、表示を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 通知と自機状態を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I will not assume my number three is finished; I will check its display.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish the notification from your own machine's status in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 友人の衣類を取り出されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Will you remove your friend's clothes?

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 本人へ連絡します。乾燥の希望を聞いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 友人の次工程を本人へ確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will contact my friend. I have not asked what they want to do about drying.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm the friend's next step with them in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 三番はまだ運転中です。

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 待ちます。私の分の通知を友人の分と分けて残します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自機終了まで待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will wait. I will keep my own notification separate from my friend's.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Wait until your own machine finishes and say so in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 五番の終了だけ確認できました。三番は運転表示に従い、扉を開けずお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: We have confirmed only that number five is finished. Follow number three's operating display and wait without opening the door.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 受付でお手伝いが必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you need help at reception?

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 声が出しにくいので、携帯に書いた内容を見てもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 筆談での説明を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: It is difficult for me to speak; could you read what I wrote on my phone?
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Request an explanation through writing in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 症状と始まった時点を書けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Can you write your symptoms and when they started?

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 昨日から喉が痛く、今朝から声が出しにくいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 症状ごとの開始時点を書く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: My throat has hurt since yesterday, and speaking has been difficult since this morning.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Write the onset of each symptom in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 付き添いの方の説明も必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do you also need your companion to explain?

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 本人の私が書きます。友人には移動だけ手伝ってもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人と付き添いの役割を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will write it myself as the patient. My friend will only help me move around.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish the patient's and companion's roles in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 必要な画面だけこちらへ見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please show me only the necessary screen.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 私的なメッセージは閉じて、症状のメモだけ示します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 必要なメモだけ提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will close my private messages and show only the note about my symptoms.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Present only the necessary note in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 診療担当へ筆談希望を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will tell the clinical staff that you prefer written communication.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。友人が答えた内容にはせず、私の記録として伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人記録として引継ぎを求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. Please pass it on as my own record, not as answers given by my friend.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for it to be passed on as the patient's own record.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご本人の症状メモと筆談希望を引き継ぎます。受付の案内も文字でお示しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will pass on your own symptom note and request for written communication. We will also show reception instructions in writing.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご予約のお客様ですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。予約者へ乳を避けることを伝えました。私の分として確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 予約経由の制限伝達を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I told the person who booked that I avoid milk. I would like to check the arrangements for my portion.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that your restriction was communicated through the booking organizer.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 店側の記録は担当に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: We will check the restaurant's record with the responsible staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 幹事へ言っただけで伝達済みとは決めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 幹事への伝達と店舗受領を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will not assume it reached the restaurant just because I told the organizer.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish telling the organizer from receipt by the restaurant in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お席とお名前をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please give your table and name.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 六名のリンです。ほかの五人は同じ希望とは限りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 対象本人と人数を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I am Lin, in a party of six. The other five do not necessarily have the same request.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Identify the person concerned and the party size in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: コース全体の材料と調理条件を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check ingredients and preparation conditions for the whole course.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 肉だけでなく、たれやデザートも確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: コース全体の確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please check not just the meat but also sauces and dessert.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request checks of the entire course in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 今は提供を止めて説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: For now, we will pause service and explain.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 説明まで私の分を取り分けずに待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 説明前の取り分けを保留する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will wait without serving out my portion until the explanation.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Hold off portioning food before the explanation in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 対象の方とコース全体の確認として担当へ報告します。対応可否は説明後に判断してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will report this as a check for the person concerned and the whole course. Please decide whether the proposed arrangements are suitable after hearing the explanation.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 予約後のお問い合わせですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this an inquiry after making a booking?

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、資料が増えました。同じ予約へ追加したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 既予約への資料追加を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes, I have more documents now. I want to add them to the same booking.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Request adding documents to an existing booking in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 予約番号はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have the booking number?

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらです。新しい相談をもう一件作る希望ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 予約番号で新件作成と区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here it is. I do not want another new consultation created.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Use the booking number to distinguish this from creating a new case in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 資料の送付方法を担当が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: The responsible staff will check how to send the materials.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 個人情報があるので、一般公開のコメント欄には書きません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 公開欄へ個人情報を書かない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: They contain personal information, so I will not write it in a publicly visible comments field.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will not put personal information in a public field.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 追加内容の分野だけ伺えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Could you tell me just the subject area of the additional material?

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 住宅契約です。予約した住居相談に関する資料です。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 資料の相談分野を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: It is a housing contract. The documents concern the housing consultation I booked.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: State the consultation field of the materials in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 事前送付か当日持参か案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will explain whether to send them in advance or bring them on the day.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 日時は変えず、資料だけ追加する方法を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 日時変更なしの追加方法を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will ask how to add only the documents without changing the date or time.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese how to add materials without changing the appointment.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 同じ予約の資料追加として担当へ確認します。送付先は案内までお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will check with the responsible staff about adding documents to the same booking. Please wait for guidance on where to send them.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お荷物のお尋ねですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 預けた上着に薬があります。開演前に取り出したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 上着内の薬の取出しを求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: There is medicine in the jacket I checked in. I would like to take it out before the performance starts.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Request retrieving medicine from the jacket in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 引換票をお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have the claim ticket?

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。荷物の保管場所へ自分で入らずお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 引換票を示し保管区画へ入らない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. Please help me without my entering the storage area myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the claim ticket and say in Japanese that you will not enter the storage area.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: いったん返却になるか確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will check whether we need to return the item to you temporarily.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 薬を取り出すだけでも再度預ける条件を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 再預けの条件を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Even if I only take out the medicine, please tell me the conditions for checking the jacket in again.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask about checking it in again in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 必要な物を取り出してから再受付できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: After taking out what you need, you can have it accepted again.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では自分で取り出します。薬の内容まで係へ広げません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 私物を本人が取り出す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I will take it out myself. I will not spread out the medicine's contents for the staff.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will retrieve your personal item yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 再受付の票をお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will give you a new claim ticket after accepting it again.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 古い票と混ぜず、新しい票を保管してから入場します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 再受付票を旧票と区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will not mix it with the old ticket; I will keep the new one safely before entering.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Distinguish the new claim ticket from the old one in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 上着をいったんお返しします。再受付後の新しい票で終演後にお受け取りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will return the jacket temporarily. After checking it in again, use the new ticket to collect it after the performance.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 検索は終点でしましたが、途中の病院前で降りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 検索終点と希望途中下車を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I searched using the final stop, but I want to get off at the hospital along the way.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Distinguish the search's final destination from your desired intermediate stop in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その便が停まるか確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us check whether that service stops there.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 予約画面には終点だけあります。途中も停まるとは決めていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 画面だけで停車と決めない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: The booking screen only lists the final stop. I have not assumed it also stops along the way.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will not assume a stop based only on the screen.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 便番号を見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please show me the service number.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: こちらです。乗る前に下車場所を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 便番号で停車確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Here it is. I want to confirm where I can get off before boarding.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Use the service number to request a stop check in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この便は病院前に停まりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: This service does not stop at the hospital.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では買うのをやめます。停まる別便と到着時間を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 未停車便を買わず別便を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I will not buy it. I want to ask about another service that stops there and its arrival time.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decline to buy the non-stopping service and request another service in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 次の便は停まりますが三十分後です。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: The next service stops there, but it is thirty minutes later.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 病院へ到着が遅れると連絡して、その便を検討します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 到着遅れの連絡方針を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will tell the hospital I will arrive late and consider that service.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: State your plan to notify the hospital of late arrival in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 現在の便は購入せず、次便の時刻と停留所の案内をお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Do not purchase the current service; please take the guidance for the next service's time and stop.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 追加注文は二皿ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: That is two additional dishes, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: すみません、送る前なら一皿へ減らしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 送信前の追加数量減を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Sorry, if you have not sent them through yet, I would like to reduce that to one dish.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Request reducing the additional quantity before it is sent in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まだ厨房へ送っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: I have not sent it to the kitchen yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: よかったです。最初の注文は変えず、追加だけ一皿にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 最初の注文を維持する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Good. I will leave the initial order unchanged and reduce only the additional order to one dish.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Keep the initial order unchanged in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 追加の飲み物は二杯でよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Are the additional drinks still two?

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。料理一皿、飲み物二杯です。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 追加料理と飲料を指定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. One dish and two drinks.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Specify the additional dish and drinks in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will send through that breakdown.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。人数は二人のままです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 人数変更なしを明示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. The number of people remains two.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Make clear in Japanese that the party size has not changed.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 変更した追加分を画面で確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can check the revised additions on the screen.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 一皿と二杯ですね。会計時にもこの追加分と最初の分を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 画面の変更と会計内訳を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: One dish and two drinks, correct. At payment, I will check both these additions and the initial order.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the screen change and bill breakdown in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認した追加の一皿と二杯を通しました。先の注文はそのままです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAWASAKI-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: I have sent through the confirmed additional dish and two drinks. The earlier order remains unchanged.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ODAWARA-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ODAWARA-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 何を確認されたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ODAWARA-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: What would you like to check?

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ODAWARA-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ODAWARA-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 添付画像は表だけです。裏にも記載がありました。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ODAWARA-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 添付裏面欠落を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ODAWARA-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: The attached image shows only the front. There was information on the back too.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ODAWARA-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report the missing reverse-side attachment in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ODAWARA-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ODAWARA-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 申告は送信しましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ODAWARA-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you submitted the tax return?

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ODAWARA-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ODAWARA-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。添付不足か、この書類を見て確認してほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ODAWARA-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 送信済みで不足確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ODAWARA-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I would like you to look at this document and check whether the attachments are insufficient.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ODAWARA-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that it is submitted and request checking for missing material.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ODAWARA-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ODAWARA-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 送信記録をお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ODAWARA-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do you have the submission record?

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ODAWARA-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ODAWARA-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: こちらです。同じ申告をもう一度作る前に相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ODAWARA-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 記録を示し再申告を保留する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ODAWARA-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Here it is. I will consult you before creating the same return again.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ODAWARA-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the record and hold off resubmitting in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ODAWARA-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ODAWARA-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 追加の方法は担当が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ODAWARA-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: The responsible staff will check how to add materials.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ODAWARA-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ODAWARA-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 元の書類は両面とも残しています。裏の写真も用意できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ODAWARA-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 原本両面を保持する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ODAWARA-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have kept both sides of the original document. I can also prepare a photograph of the back.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ODAWARA-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you retain both sides of the original.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ODAWARA-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ODAWARA-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 通知や期限の案内は来ていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ODAWARA-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Have you received any notice or deadline instructions?

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ODAWARA-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ODAWARA-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: まだです。追加が必要なら方法と期限を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ODAWARA-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 追加方法と期限を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ODAWARA-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Not yet. If additions are necessary, I would like to ask how and by when to send them.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ODAWARA-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Request the method and deadline for additions in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ODAWARA-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ODAWARA-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 送信記録と両面の書類を担当へ引き継ぎます。重複送信はせず案内をお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ODAWARA-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will pass the submission record and two-sided document to the responsible staff. Do not submit a duplicate; please wait for guidance.

DLG-SC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-001-SHARED-01.translation: Will you be boarding with a car?

DLG-SC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。この車両一台の予約に三人も含まれますか。
DLG-SC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 車両予約の人数範囲を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. Does this reservation for one vehicle also include three people?
DLG-SC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese which people are covered by the vehicle booking.

DLG-SC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 予約内訳を見せてください。

DLG-SC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 車と運転者一人とあります。同乗者二人は別ですね。
DLG-SC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 運転者と同乗者の内訳を読む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-001-SHARED-04.translation: It says one car and one driver. The two passengers are separate, correct?
DLG-SC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Read the driver and passenger breakdown in Japanese.

DLG-SC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 追加の条件を担当が確認します。
DLG-SC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-001-SHARED-05.translation: The responsible staff will check the conditions for adding them.

DLG-SC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 同乗者が先に徒歩の列へ並ぶ前に、方法を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 徒歩列へ進む前に方法確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-001-SHARED-06.translation: I would like to hear the procedure before the passengers join the pedestrian queue first.
DLG-SC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm the procedure before joining the pedestrian queue in Japanese.

DLG-SC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 車両の受付と人の乗船方法を案内します。
DLG-SC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will explain vehicle check-in and how people board.

DLG-SC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 三人で同じ便です。別便になる手続きは希望しません。
DLG-SC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 全員同便を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-001-SHARED-08.translation: All three of us are on the same sailing. I do not want a procedure that puts us on separate sailings.
DLG-SC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want everyone on the same sailing.

DLG-SC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 車種や人数に変更はありますか。
DLG-SC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-001-SHARED-09.translation: Are there changes to the vehicle type or number of people?

DLG-SC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 車は同じです。二人の追加と合計料金を確認してください。
DLG-SC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 車変更なしと追加料金確認を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-001-SHARED-10.translation: The car is unchanged. Please check the addition of two people and the total fare.
DLG-SC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that the vehicle is unchanged and request a check of additional charges.

DLG-SC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 一台、運転者一人、同乗者二人として担当へ照会します。並ぶ場所は説明後にご案内します。
DLG-SC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will ask the responsible staff about one vehicle, one driver, and two passengers. We will show you where to queue after explaining the procedure.
